findings.rationale: Step 8 download failed with 'bash: syntax error near unexpected token `('' because the -o template with parentheses was unquoted. Recovered immediately in Step 9 by quoting the argument; no material impact.

Step 35 block-based extraction produced only 2 blocks (TOTAL 2) because tesseract inconsistently detects the empty '>' prompt, so block delimiting failed. Agent recognized the failure and switched to per-frame raw extraction (Step 36), recovering the approach.
